replay_matches_sampling.fixes: sampling and replay now share one advance/mask path (previously ~0.05)

ppo_ratio_before_update_is_one.fixes: the update recomputes probabilities through the same masked distribution

mask_applied_in_update.fixes: the update softmaxes over the mask, not over all 180 actions

behaviour_probability_is_mixture.fixes: with epsilon=1 the recorded probability is the uniform mixture, not the policy's

time_axis_matches_physics_steps.fixes: the boundary observation is the last inner frame; no extra period per skill

observation_fields_same_meaning.fixes: column 28 is the sensed distance in both; column 30 is the shared clock

branch_executes_candidate_and_snapshot.fixes: the candidate is forced and the snapshot is restored after the reset

skill_reward_matches_hand_calculation.fixes: gamma**n * Phi(next) - Phi(now) - c * sum_j gamma**j, per-period time cost

bootstrap_only_on_sampling_cut.fixes: a task-budget end is a real terminal; only the sampler cut bootstraps

progress_sign_documented.fixes: positive distance_change means farther; progress is its negation

interrupt_resume_continues.fixes: an interrupted run continues from the saved optimiser and iteration counter

resumable_and_inference_checkpoints_are_.fixes: the final save no longer strips the optimiser from the resumable file
